steps.en: Open the assignment1 BPE notebook and prepare its environment and local text
steps.zh: 打开作业1的 BPE 笔记本，准备环境与本地文本

steps.en: Correct the input paths and set the vocabulary size before running the training cell
steps.zh: 纠正输入路径，设置词表大小，再运行训练单元

steps.en: Stream normalized byte-level text into the BPE trainer
steps.zh: 将规范化的字节级文本流送入 BPE 训练器

steps.en: Save the learned tokenizer as tokenizer.json in the chosen output directory
steps.zh: 将学得的分词器保存为输出目录中的 tokenizer.json

value.en: A tokenizer built from your local text through one inspectable exercise, not a whole-course runner
value.zh: 通过一份可读作业从本地文本构建分词器，不是自动跑完整门课程
